name: Pacify The Centaur
summary: At Freewind Post, you face the Galak camp below. Cliffwatcher Longhorn wants the threat at Splithoof Crag cut down before it reaches the tauren post.

sections.title: A Threat on the Canyon Floor
sections.body: Freewind Post stands on a desert mesa above Thousand Needles. From there, the tauren watch the canyon floor, where enemies gather beneath the ropes and lifts. The Galak centaur have built a war camp at Splithoof Crag, directly north along the canyon wall. Their camp threatens the supply lines and tauren movement through the needles.

sections.title: Retaliation and Bloodshed
sections.body: Cliffwatcher Longhorn sends Horde travelers to weaken the Galak ranks. The tauren believe Freewind Post will be safe only when the centaur vanguard is broken in its own camp. Galak Scouts, Galak Wranglers, and Galak Windchasers all face the fight. Their deaths may blunt an attack before it reaches the post.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Pacify the Centaur?
faq.answer: Cliffwatcher Longhorn gives the order from atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. He helps defend the post and watches the dangers across the surrounding salt flats and canyons.

faq.q: Where are the Galak centaur located?
faq.answer: The Galak centaur camp lies directly north of Freewind Post, against the northern cliff wall of Thousand Needles. It is called Splithoof Crag.

faq.q: Why do the tauren want the centaur killed?
faq.answer: The Galak have camped at the foot of Freewind Post, and Cliffwatcher Longhorn wants them killed to protect the Horde's desert stronghold. The centaur have also long waged a brutal war against nomadic tauren across central Kalimdor.

faq.q: What kinds of centaur need to be slain?
faq.answer: You hunt twelve Galak Scouts, ten Galak Wranglers, and six Galak Windchasers at Splithoof Crag.

faq.q: What comes after completing Pacify the Centaur?
faq.answer: Once the Galak ranks are thinned, Cliffwatcher Longhorn turns to other dangers nearby and sends you after Grimtotem Spying.

faq.q: What pre-requisite leads into this mission?
aliases: how to unlock pacify the centaur
faq.answer: Message to Freewind Post leads you here. It asks travelers to report directly to Cliffwatcher Longhorn.

angles.text: As shu'halo, you know centaur camps near a settlement recall generations of slaughter. Thinning the Galak is a matter of survival for your people.
As a member of the Horde, you know Freewind Post keeps the road open between the Great Lift and the Shimmering Flats. Aggressive centaur beneath its towers endanger every caravan crossing the zone.
